hypothesis: The homogeneous EML grammar S → 1 | eml(S,S) has no 1-D integer invariant like degree. Exhaustive enumeration through 6 internal nodes matches Catalan counts and exhibits same-size trees with different closed values. US-4′ is withheld.

controls.description: Tree counts by internal-node number must equal C_k. This is independent of evaluation.
Evaluation uses real exp/log. Nonpositive right-hand arguments and overflow are undefined, not coerced to a finite value.
10-decimal numerical fiber ids are disclosed as a computational clustering. This grammar is constant; a variable-EML spectrum is not claimed.
The run must not claim that fiber mass predicts gradient recovery.

gates.criterion: Two equal-internal-node trees have different closed real values; hand identities hold.
Counts match Catalan C_k for k=0..6.
Summary records the finite-grid / rounding caveat.
